source.name: dnata media centre, dnata nets three-year deal with Dubai Basketball as Founding Partner
source.quote: dnata's branding will appear on Dubai Basketball's official jerseys, across the Coca-Cola Arena home court
source.note: Three-year Founding Partner (2025-26 to 2027-28). The club store's photo of the 2026/27 home jersey (https://store.dubaibasketball.com/products/jersey-players-version-white-home, https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0765/6806/8250/files/DSC05782.jpg) shows the dnata wordmark across the front, under the number.

source.name: Dubai Basketball: Dubai Basketball and Mr. Eight Development Announce Three-Year Exclusive Partnership
source.quote: the Mr. Eight brand will feature on Dubai Basketball's game jerseys throughout the club's EuroLeague and ABA League campaigns
source.note: The club store's photo of the 2026/27 home jersey (https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0765/6806/8250/files/DSC05782.jpg) shows 'MR.EIGHT' on the chest, under the adidas logo.

source.name: Equiti: Equiti signs as founding partner of Dubai Basketball ahead of EuroLeague debut
source.quote: Equiti will feature prominently on official jerseys and courtside at the Coca-Cola Arena
source.note: Founding Partner and Official Digital Wealth Partner for three seasons from 2025-26. The club store's photo of the back of the 2026/27 home jersey (https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0765/6806/8250/files/DSC05168.jpg) shows the Equiti logo between the player's name and the number. equiti.com blocks scripts; read in the Wayback Machine copy of 22 January 2026 (https://web.archive.org/web/20260122005347/https://www.equiti.com/sc-en/media-room/media-releases/equiti-signs-as-founding-partner-of-dubai-basketball-ahead-of-euroleague-debut/).

source.name: Dubai Basketball: Audi, Al Nabooda Automobiles Powers Dubai Basketball's Season with Strategic Partnership
source.quote: Audi, Al Nabooda Automobiles proudly announces its strategic partnership with Dubai Basketball as the teams' Official Automotive Partner
source.note: Three-season deal from 2025-26. The club store's side photo of the 2026/27 home kit (https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0765/6806/8250/files/DSC06843.jpg) and the photo in the club's kit launch article (https://www.dubaibasketball.com/media-article/dubai-basketball-unveils-2026-27-kit-dedicated-to-city-of-dubai) show the Audi rings on the leg of the shorts, beside the adidas logo.

source.name: Dubai Basketball: Dubai Basketball Unveils 2026/27 Kit Dedicated to City of Dubai
source.quote: Created in partnership with adidas, the new jerseys reflect Dubai Basketball’s unique connection to the city it represents.
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention. The adidas logo is on the chest and on the shorts (https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0765/6806/8250/files/DSC05782.jpg, https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0765/6806/8250/files/DSC06843.jpg).

summary: 2026/27 adidas home kit ('Made to Belong', unveiled 12 September 2026): dnata across the front, Mr. Eight on the chest under the adidas logo, Equiti on the back between the name and the number, and the Audi rings (Al Nabooda Automobiles) on the shorts. Marked complete: the club store's photos of the home jersey and shorts, front, side and back (https://store.dubaibasketball.com/products/jersey-players-version-white-home), and the launch article's photo show no other sponsor. The patch on the other side of the chest is the EuroLeague's own mark with its partner Etihad (see the euroleague-etihad deal), not a club sponsor. The Dubai logo and visitdubai.com of the 2025 DET deal aren't on the back of this shirt; the word 'DUBAI' under the number is.
